portal_hypertension.title: International Expert Delphi Consensus on Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Portosystemic Pressure Gradient: Best Practices and Future Directions.

portal_hypertension.authors: Wang TJ, Chang K, Rubin RA

portal_hypertension.abstract: Endoscopic ultrasound guided portosystemic pressure gradient (EUS-PPG) measurement is an increasingly utilized technique that allows for direct measurement of hepatic and portal venous pressures. However, practice variability exists with this novel technique. Using the modified Delphi process, we aimed to establish consensus among international experts regarding best practices and future research for EUS-PPG. A steering committee developed consensus statements covering 4 domains: indications, pre-procedural protocol, intra-procedural technique, and future research.
